fox_gift.discover_line: The fox leads you to a hollow log — inside, a carved wooden lantern, kept safe for years.
fox_gift.hint: Befriend the fox and follow where it leads.
fox_gift.journal_text: I followed the fox to a hollow log. Hidden inside was a small carved wooden lantern. Someone — or something — has been keeping it safe.
fox_gift.title: The fox's gift

fox_trail.discover_line: Tiny red-paw prints wind away from the forest path — the fox has been going somewhere.
fox_trail.hint: Watch the fox. It remembers the way.
fox_trail.journal_text: I found a trail of small red paw-prints near the forest path. The fox is restless, and it keeps looking toward the old parts of the village.
fox_trail.title: Paw-print trail

garden_marker.discover_line: A stone marker, worn smooth: '…the light of the world…' — only fragments remain.
garden_marker.hint: Search the garden beds for stone.
garden_marker.journal_text: A stone marker stands in the forgotten garden, worn smooth by weather. I can read only fragments: '…the light of the world…'. The rest is lost.
garden_marker.title: The worn stone marker

garden_offering.discover_line: You lay three crops in the old stone trough. The garden seems to breathe again.
garden_offering.hint: The old trough remembers harvests. Bring an offering of three crops.
garden_offering.journal_text: I brought an offering of three crops and laid them in the garden's old stone trough. For a moment the weeds seemed to lean toward the sun.
garden_offering.title: An offering of harvest

garden_overgrown.discover_line: Behind the café, choked with weeds: an old garden, planted in careful rows.
garden_overgrown.journal_text: Behind the café I found an old garden, swallowed by weeds but planted in careful rows. This was somebody's beloved work.
garden_overgrown.title: The overgrown garden

hannah_memory.discover_line: Hannah remembers: the village used to gather at the Garden of Hope and read Scripture together.
hannah_memory.hint: Talk to Hannah about the old days.
hannah_memory.journal_text: Hannah told me the village used to gather at the Garden of Hope — neighbors, friends, everyone — to read Scripture together. 'We called it the Old Gathering,' she said.
hannah_memory.title: Hannah's memory

nathan_riddle.discover_line: Pastor Nathan's riddle is answered: LIGHT — 'I am the light of the world.' (John 8:12)
nathan_riddle.hint: Ask Pastor Nathan his riddle. The answer is in John 8:12.
nathan_riddle.journal_text: Pastor Nathan asked me a riddle, and the answer was waiting in the verse stand: LIGHT. 'I am the light of the world: he that followeth me shall not walk in darkness, but shall have the light of life.' (John 8:12)
nathan_riddle.title: Pastor Nathan's riddle

stone_first.discover_line: Half-buried where the river bends: a stone carved with a rising sun.
stone_first.hint: One stone sleeps where the river bends.
stone_first.journal_text: Where the river bends I dug out a fallen stone, warm to the touch. It is carved with a rising sun.
stone_first.title: The ember stone

stone_matched.discover_line: The symbols match the arch carvings — sun, wheat, wave, star. The stones were markers for a gathering.
stone_matched.hint: Match each stone's symbol to the arch carvings.
stone_matched.journal_text: I matched each stone's symbol to a carving on the ruin arch: sun, wheat, wave, star. The four stones were markers — they pointed the way to a gathering place.
stone_matched.title: The stones' witness

stone_second.discover_line: At the end of the forest path: a stone soft with moss, carved with wheat.
stone_second.hint: One stone sleeps where the forest path ends.
stone_second.journal_text: At the end of the forest path I found a second fallen stone, soft with moss, carved with wheat.
stone_second.title: The moss stone

lines: Travelers gather at the Garden of Hope, and the old lanterns are lit one by one.
The garden wakes. The village wakes. What was forgotten is remembered.
One village. One Light. A hope discovered together.
ending.title: The Garden of Hope

note: A non-linear mystery in four threads. The threads may be solved in any order. All threads converge on the revelation: Jesus Christ is the Light (John 8:12, from the verified KJV pool). The travelers restore a community — they are never the savior.

revelation.text: Every thread points to one truth. The fox's loyalty. The garden's memory. The stones' witness. The old gathering's song. Jesus Christ is the Light — and the travelers are here to restore a community, never to save it.
revelation.title: The First Light
revelation.verse_line: Then spake Jesus again unto them, saying, I am the light of the world: he that followeth me shall not walk in darkness, but shall have the light of life.

fox.subtitle: A red thread through the wilds.
fox.title: The Fox

old_gathering.subtitle: What the village used to be.
old_gathering.title: The Old Gathering

title: THE FIRST LIGHT
